name: ai-content-manager
description: A **local, Claude-Code-orchestrated** workflow that turns raw recordings into finished, on-brand **9:16 short-form videos** (Reels / Shorts / TikTok) — no web app, no server. You drop a recording in a folder, say "edit these," approve a quick plan, and finished shorts show up on your phone via Google Drive. Raw footage archives itself; the pipeline stays clean.
